brief:
Israeli military data shows aid deliveries to Gaza have fallen well short of the 4,200 trucks weekly pledged under the ceasefire agreement, Middle East Eye reported. Most weeks have seen deliveries remain below that commitment.

The figures emerge as ceasefire terms require sustained aid flows to address acute shortages across Gaza. Israel's own records document the ongoing gap between promised and actual humanitarian access.

title: Israel allows half promised aid trucks into Gaza
